title: The Glass of Lemon Water
youtube_title: The Glass of Lemon Water | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Zola sees that a glass of lemon water sweating on the sill will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Zola makes a smaller, even share so Greta is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
